# AI Symphony

AI Symphony is a multi-agent CLI tool that orchestrates AI agents to generate production-ready code or validate business ideas. It uses CrewAI to coordinate specialized agents (PM, Developer, Reviewer, Financial Modeler).

## Architecture
- CLI: Click (Python)
- Agent Framework: CrewAI
- LLM Backend: OpenAI API / Local models
- Output: GitHub Pull Requests or Markdown reports

## File Structure
- symphony/           - Main package
- symphony/agents/    - Agent definitions (PM, Developer, Critic, etc.)
- symphony/crews/     - Crew orchestration logic
- symphony/tools/     - Custom tools for agents
- templates/          - Prompt templates

## Key Decisions
- Dual modes: Code generation vs Business validation
- GitHub API integration for direct PR creation
- Modular agent design for easy swapping

## How to Extend
1. Add new agents in symphony/agents/
2. Create new crew workflows in symphony/crews/
3. Add custom tools in symphony/tools/
